name: gitdebt-extension
author: Internet Technology Services LLC
description: gitdebt browser extension — star history & repo-debt analytics on GitHub repo pages. Chrome + Firefox (MV3).

scripts.start:firefox: npx --yes web-ext@10 run --source-dir=. --target=firefox-desktop --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules build.mjs dist README.md PRIVACY.md .gitignore web-ext-artifacts test
scripts.start:chrome: npx --yes web-ext@10 run --source-dir=. --target=chromium --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules build.mjs dist README.md PRIVACY.md .gitignore web-ext-artifacts test
scripts.package: npm test && npm run lint && node build.mjs
